name: Agustín Arana
profileSummary: Agustín Arana is a Mexican actor and singer. He was a member of the Mexican singing group Garibaldi. This was the second Garibaldi group that succeeded the first group of the same name. He grew up in a farm and had many horses. His favorite was Lagartijó, a loyal animal who only let Agustín mount it. He was a semi-professional boxer and fought throughout Mexico.
